parts.note_add: Pierce ships the K678 kit with a genuine Weber 45 DCOE, manifold, soft mounts, part of the linkage and mounting hardware, no intake gasket and no instructions; as-shipped jetting main 180, idle 65F9, pump 90, air corrector 175, emulsion F16, needle and seat 250. Exploded parts drawing (carbparts.eu) and the D V Andrews DCOE selection/tuning guide are in datasheets/PT006.

Check: the recorded Pegasus link (RecId 8118) is a Facet cylindrical pump FAC-476459 (6-8 psi, 32 GPH), not a Carter P4070 - read the number off the pump on the car. Carter's instruction sheet (datasheets/PT007) asks for a 10 A fuse, 14 AWG wire, an inlet filter, and mounting no more than 24 in above the top of the tank.

Pegasus product 1135 is the Holley 1-4 psi carburetted regulator (Holley 12-804 by its range and 3/8 NPT ports - check the number on the body): dead-head type, no return port, factory preset about 2.7 psi. Holley instruction 199R7914-3 is in datasheets/PT008.

FF3429DL is the Duralast equivalent of the factory E508-13-470 cartridge (cross-reference list: Luber-Finer G803 direct, Wix 33066/33204, Fram G4775/G6458, Purolator F23170, Motorcraft FG803). AutoZone's page refuses automated reads, so inlet/outlet size is not recorded - check the filter.

The Amazon listing is an ERYUE 'First Inertia Switch' crash sensor - a Ford-style inertia switch that opens the electric fuel pump circuit on impact, not a valve. Check the fitted unit, its reset button location and where it sits in the Carter pump feed.
HOUSUN 3/8 in ID NBR fuel hose, 300 psi rated, sold as 10 ft with 10 clamps.
K&N makes oval DCOE filters in several depths (Moss 222-240 is the 3 in deep 45 DCOE filter, 222-245 the 1-3/4 in; K&N 56-1350 is the 3.25 in tall oval); read the number off the top plate.

One-way valve in the return line, flowing toward the tank only; a clogged one lets fuel back-wash and flood the carburettor after shutdown (rx7club). No supplier lists 3648-13-270A; the 1985 manual gives the replacement procedure and the arrow direction on 4A-50.

New canisters are not listed; used 1981-83 12A canisters appear on eBay and autopart3 (sold out at 55 USD). The NHTSA recall list for the 1982 RX-7 (S-055) holds only 85V108 (idler arm), so 'campaign 21605' is a Mazda service campaign number, not a NHTSA one - check the dealer service history.
Sits near the oil filler pipe, purging canister vapour into the intake above idle. Atkins lists 1480-20-950A at 79.95 USD but no longer available; Mazda dealer sites still list the number.
Mazdatrix stocks the 79-83 gas pedal pad 8871-41-711B (16.68 USD).
Atkins lists the factory cable FA01-41-660 at 75 USD, out of stock with limited remaining supply.
No new or reproduction tank exists for the 1981-83 car; used tanks appear on autopartone (349 USD, sold out) and eBay. Removal and hose insertion figures are in the 1985 manual 4A-48/49.
Still sold new by Atkins (129.99 USD, with gasket) and Mazda dealers. Two-wire resistive sender: Y signal to the fuel gauge, B to ground (1982 diagram, connector C-01).
Atkins lists 8871-42-210C at 75 USD, no longer available with a few left; the cap screws straight onto this neck.

Atkins stocks the OEM cap 8871-42-250B (21.11 USD). Owners report the stock cap is not vented (the tank vents through the canister) and came branded Gates or Stant; PartsGeek lists Motorad MGC763 as the aftermarket fit.
This is the 'check and cut valve' of the evaporative line: it relieves tank pressure or vacuum and stops fuel loss if the car overturns; test pressures are in the specs (1985 manual).

specs.item: Purge valve check

specs.note: Test with the purge valve to oil filler pipe hose disconnected.

specs.item: Accelerator pedal height below the brake pedal
specs.note: Adjust at nut A on the cable; 1985 manual.

specs.item: Full-throttle check

specs.note: Written for the Nikki; the Weber's linkage is custom.

specs.item: Accelerator cable free play at the carburettor
specs.note: Adjust at nut B; factory Nikki figure, the car's cable is a spliced hybrid.
